scenes.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / illustration-story. Create ONE PRODUCTION ANIMATION SPRITE STRIP, EXACTLY 3072x768 pixels: 3 equal 1024x768 4:3 animation cels side by side, ONE row, no gutters/borders. Preserve equal cel dimensions and clear vertical cel boundaries. Consecutive articulated character poses: do NOT fake action by sliding/zooming a whole static illustration. Same-location actions MUST use identical background, camera distance, character size and placement; only limbs, hands, expressions and contacted props change. Travel/entry across locations may change environment deliberately to show the narrated progression. Original reference image is assets/images/stories/brushing_teeth.png. IDENTITY LOCK: Boy: layered tousled dark brown hair, large dark brown eyes, warm peach skin, rounded rosy cheeks, blue collared shirt. Preserve original yellow toothbrush shape and blue bathroom/yellow towel visual palette; omit the unrelated second implement. Narration for context, never print words: Our teeth are clean and shiny! We brush in the morning and at night. Required location(s): bathroom mirror. Emotion: quiet pride, happy. Props/contact: clean toothbrush in holder, sink. FRAME 1: put clean brush in holder. FRAME 2: look in mirror and smile showing clean teeth. FRAME 3: relax hands. Show ALL narrated beats in this ordered strip, each cel a distinct meaningful action pose. Use exact reference faces, hair, eye shape, skin, clothes, proportions and warm premium 2D children's cartoon rendering. Full uncropped heads with visible space ABOVE hair and around all active hands/props in EVERY frame; 10% safe margin around heads. Full body and feet visible for walking/sitting/standing actions. Keep hands anatomically coherent and props held or supported correctly. No text, speech bubbles, labels, numbers, watermark or logos. For toilet scenes conceal all private anatomy behind privacy partition or non-explicit clothing, never draw nudity. For roads child remains behind curb until adult checks safe crossing; never step into road on red pedestrian light. For personal space never hug or touch without consent. Asset id: brushing_teeth-p6. FRAMING OVERRIDE: medium-wide full-room shot in EVERY cel, characters at most75% of cel height, CLEAR EMPTY WALL ABOVE every complete hair/head by at least70pixels. Do NOT repeat cropped reference composition. All active hands and tools fully visible.
